title: The Bridge of Nagasaki's harbor
author: A. M. Reyes
blurb: Mirabel Sandoval, an apprentice clockmaker summoned to repair the observatory's master clock, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
